instruction: Can you change the maximum volume limit to 200%? The default 125% is too quiet for some videos.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC max volume setting from default 125% to 200%. Uses existing check_qt_max_volume metric to validate the qt-max-volume setting in vlcrc config file.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_vlc_config) correctly reads VLC configuration file from OS-specific path (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc for Linux)
Metric (check_qt_max_volume) correctly parses config file and extracts qt-max-volume setting value
Metric properly handles default value (125) when setting is not explicitly configured
Expected value '200' correctly matches instruction requirement to change maximum volume to 200%
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config changes are persisted and not just cached in memory
Complete instruction coverage - single requirement (change max volume to 200%) is fully verified
Proper edge case handling: missing config file, missing setting, type conversion (int/string)
Semantic verification is precise and unambiguous - evaluator can definitively determine if task was completed
